name: Duet Fist
description: Throw a fist in time with a partner's so the two blows land one after another on the same spot.

name: Duet Step
description: Step in counterpoint to a partner so the pair circles an opponent without crossing paths.

name: Duet Guard
description: Hold a thickened guard in tune with a partner's so each covers the other's open side.

name: Duet Surge
description: Pour both pulses into one linked strike that arrives from two angles at the same instant.

name: Counterbeat
description: Beat against the rhythm of the target's pulse to throw their timing and open their guard.

name: Harmony Mend
description: Tune two pulses to one pitch and let the partner's strength flow into the wound of the other.

name: Duet Bind
description: Tie the target with two cords of blood-qi pulled by two partners from opposite sides.

name: Resonant Heartbeats
description: Let two heartbeats ring together until the strike thrown on the crest lands with doubled weight.

name: Convergent Pair
description: Send two waves of pulse-force from two bodies to meet at one point and burst there.

name: Heartsunder
description: Break the rhythm of the target's heart with a paired strike that tears the guard apart.

name: Heartduet
description: The school's duet in which two linked hearts build one great beat and release it in a combined strike.

name: Vein Opener
description: Open a surface vein of the user's own forearm and flick the blood forward as a stinging spatter.

name: Gush Step
description: Gush blood to the legs for a sudden lurch of speed that ends in a settled stance.

name: Clot Ward
description: Clot the opened veins with a thickening pulse so the wound does not cost the user more than planned.

name: Wrist Vent
description: Vent a jet of pressured blood-qi from the wrist in a hissing line at the target.

name: Gushing Palm
description: Slap a palm wet with blood-qi across the face so the hot spray blinds and jars the target.

name: Seepage Bind
description: Let blood-qi seep along the ground and creep over the target's feet to hold them.

name: Vein Cascade
description: Open every vein in the arms at once and let the blood-qi cascade out in a wide fan.

name: Torrent Gash
description: Cut with a torrent of pressured blood that gashes deep as it passes through the guard.

name: Fountain Wound
description: Open a wound in the target that fountains blood-qi and does not close under normal means.

name: Crimson Fountain
description: The school's fountain in which the user opens the veins in order and releases the flood in a rising arc.

name: Dive Claw
description: Drop from a crouch and rake down with blood-weighted fingers at the target's collarbone.

name: Crimson Plume
description: Flick a plume of red qi from the fingertips that spreads and stings at mid range.

name: Liftwing Step
description: Spring upward on a hot pulse to clear a low sweep and land with the point already aimed.

name: Hawkguard
description: Beat the forearms across the face to bat down a flurry like a hawk fending off a rival.

name: Plunge Rake
description: Plunge a raking hand down the target's back that weakens the muscle along the spine.

name: Warmair Sense
description: Feel the rising heat of living bodies and judge each pulse by the lift of the air above it.

name: Rising Talons
description: Drive crooked fingers upward through the soft gap beneath the ribs on the lift of a step.

name: Pinion Bind
description: Pin a target's arms to its sides with bands of blood-qi like a bird's folded wings.

name: Diving Rend
description: Dive from height onto a marked target and rend open the shoulder with a hooked blow.

name: Soaring Heartbeat
description: Beat the heart at a soaring pace that lifts every stride off the ground in long arcs.

name: Zenith Plunge
description: Flash to the top of a leap and plunge onto the target before its eyes follow.

name: Crimson Dive
description: The school's dive in which the hawk's whole weight and the blood of the body fall onto one point.

name: Deep Pulse
description: Sink the attention to a slow deep pulse beneath the quick one and read the body by it.

name: Weighty Fist
description: Swing a fist heavy with slow deep blood that lands like a dropped weight.

name: Drumpace
description: Pace a single heavy step to the slow beat and feel the ground carry it.

name: Drumroll Barrage
description: Roll a barrage of heavy blows to a mounting beat that builds until the guard shakes.

name: Corebeat Guard
description: Hold a guard set on the slow beat of the Core that does not ripple under blows.

name: Greatbeat Mend
description: Send one great slow beat into a hurt body so the whole wound closes in rhythm.

name: Thunderous Bind
description: Pound the ground with the great beat so that bands of force rise up and bind the legs.

name: Heart Thunder
description: Release the great beat as a roll of thunder that shakes bodies and shatters guards around the user.

name: Ageless Pulse
description: Hold the great pulse so even that age and fatigue slide off and the guard stands without tiring.

name: Titan Beat
description: Drop one colossal beat of the Core through a single blow that shatters what it touches.

name: Great Pulse
description: The school's great pulse in which the second track beats once and every body in reach is shaken to the bone.

name: Pulse Gust
description: Gust a palm forward on the surge of the pulse so wind and blood strike together.

name: Windshear Step
description: Cut sideways across the line of a rush like a shear of wind and come up at the opponent's flank.

name: Headwind Parry
description: Face an oncoming blow into the wind and parry it off the thickened forearm.

name: Rearwind Surge
description: Take a wind at the back and a surge in the blood and carry both into a lunging blow.

name: Zephyr Mend
description: Brush a light wind over a fresh cut with warmed blood so it seals for an ally or the self.

name: Breezebind
description: Wrap a target's legs in ribbons of light wind and blood that grow tighter as it strains.

name: Gale Hemorrhage
description: Strike with a gale-fast hand that bursts vessels beneath the skin and starts a rapid bleed.

name: Squall Barrage
description: Hold a long squall of blood-qi droplets that hammers a target from a distance.

name: Whirlblood Strike
description: Whirl the blood of the body into a spinning blow that cuts through every guard around.

name: Windward Pulse
description: The school's run in which the pulse and the wind keep one pace and break on the target as a single blow.

name: Blood Compass
description: Take a bearing on the nearest pulse and keep it in mind through every turn of the body.

name: Pulsed Fist
description: Throw a fist along a line fixed by the pulse so it cannot wander from the mark.

name: Levelblood Guard
description: Hold the blood level in the arms so the guard stays steady on the line of the blow.

name: Plumbline Step
description: Step straight down the plumb line of the opponent's center without any lean.

name: Lineward Surge
description: Surge forward down the fixed line and meet the opponent where the bearing ends.

name: Sighted Jab
description: Sight along a pulse and stab at its vessel through any cover the target tries.

name: Courseblood Mend
description: Hold a true course of warmed blood into a wound and keep it flowing until it closes.

name: Fixed Bind
description: Fix a binding thread on a pulse so it follows the target wherever it turns.

name: Truebearing Rupture
description: Rupture a vessel along the bearing in one unerring thrust that leaves the limb weak.

name: Steady Torrent
description: Hold a steady torrent of blood-qi on the bearing without waver and drive it into the target.

name: Unerring Pulse
description: Send a pulse along the bearing that finds its mark through any cover and wounds from within.

name: Bearing Blood
description: The school's blow in which a true bearing is set in the pulse and the strike follows it to the end.

name: Open Chest Fist
description: Throw a fist from an open stance with the chest bared and the whole pulse behind the blow.

name: Bareskin Guard
description: Take a blow on bare skin hardened by a quick pulse so it feels the force without the wound.

name: Exposed Step
description: Step in close with the guard dropped and the blood hot in the legs to cut off the angle.

name: Unguarded Surge
description: Drive a surge of blood into a blow thrown with no guard and no thought of defense.

name: Bare Rebound
description: Take a hit on the bare chest and fling part of it back along the striker's arm.

name: Heartlight Mend
description: Open the chest and let warm blood-light flow into an ally's wound through a joined palm.

name: Open Hand Bind
description: Hold out an open hand and bind the target by the sworn word until it clenches.

name: Unshuttered Heart
description: Throw open the heart without a shutter and draw strength from the very blows that hit it.

name: Exposed Torrent
description: Loose the whole pulse in a torrent from the bared chest that flings back all within reach.

name: Heart Bared
description: Bare the heart to a blow and drink its force into the chest to throw it back as a strike.

name: Heart Unwalled
description: The school's open heart in which no guard is raised and all the force taken is released in a sworn burst.

name: Stormvow Fist
description: Throw a fist under a vow to the storm so the pulse and thunder fall together.

name: Deep Vow Guard
description: Hold a guard backed by a vow sunk deep into the Core that gives no ground.

name: Sworn Gale Step
description: Step on a sworn bearing with the gale at the heels and cross a wide gap.

name: Pledge Tempest
description: Stamp a pledge into the ground and let a small tempest of blood-qi spin out from it.

name: Oath Rebound
description: Hold the oath through a blow and send its weight back to the striker.

name: Bond Mend
description: Pass the user's sworn vigor to a bonded ally through the pulse to close a deep wound.

name: Sworn Heartstorm
description: Beat the heart to a sworn storm and release it in a ring of crashing blows.

name: Vow Hurricane
description: Raise a hurricane sworn to a bearing that sweeps along it and tears down what it meets.

name: Stormoath Strike
description: Strike under a storm oath so the blow binds the target's breath and blood in one jolt.

name: Oath Gale
description: The school's gale in which the oath and the storm pulse fuse and sweep all before the swearer.
